title: Multiple Choice - Sentence Completion
description: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

questions.text: The international school hosted a __________ forum where students from Asia and Europe shared historical perspectives.
Driving across the misty mountain pass at night proved difficult because the narrow roads were completely __________ to the driver.
Archaeological evidence indicates that early pottery techniques did not __________ in the lowlands, but in remote highland valleys.
The coastal village came alive with joyful __________ as acoustic bands performed and colorful lanterns illuminated the harbor.
Each theatrical performer stepped onto the stage wearing an elaborate historical __________ made of embroidered silk and lace.
Mediterranean __________ emphasizes cold-pressed olive oil, fresh garlic, fragrant herbs, and abundant grilled seafood.
Aromatic star anise is a primary __________ that gives traditional pho broth its signature warm and comforting fragrance.
Shopping for upcycled garments at weekend flea markets has become a stylish eco-friendly __________ among high school teenagers.
Modern interior architects often __________ raw concrete walls with polished wood surfaces to produce a balanced, contemporary look.
Traditional Japanese woodblock prints exerted a notable __________ on European impressionist painters during the late nineteenth century.
